camera.perspective_cues: Shelf grid (cubbies) seen nearly frontally: vertical shelf dividers at image y ~165-210, ~375-415, ~575-620, ~780-825, ~985-1030 and column edges at x ~480/640, ~705/865, ~930/1080 run parallel to the image axes -> wall nearly parallel to the image plane. Sofa / rug at left are seen obliquely (rug is a trapezoid, x 108-250). No horizon visible. Person's head width (~47 px) and head-top x (~705) stay constant over the walk -> the walk is nearly parallel to the image plane at almost constant camera distance.
